videos.script: Two smaller providers, each worth knowing for one thing. {{cohere}} Cohere sells the Command models. Its newest is priced at zero in the sheet, and at three other prices elsewhere. A zero means unknown, so you go to the maker. {{rerank}} Cohere is known for reranking: putting documents in order of how well they answer a question. It writes nothing, and it is billed per query. {{mistral}} Mistral is French, sells models through an API, and publishes open weights for many of them. Names say purpose: Magistral reasons, Devstral writes code. {{wire}} And its API uses the same path and shape as OpenAI's. Only the key says whose account pays.
